violations.text: Cocktail sauce and seafood salad were observed held at 42-43 degrees Fahrenheit in Seafood walk-in cooler. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All TCS foods were placed into meat walk-in during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

-Seafood walk-in cooler was observed at 43-45 degrees Fahrenheit. All seafood were in styrofoam coolers with ice and in correct temperatures. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. Proofs of repairs to be sent to inspector. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The following were observed in poor repair: 1. deli walk-in cooler coving 2. deli wall 3. deli warewashing area floor tiles and grout Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2025

Raw animal foods such as raw fish were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as cooked lobster in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were replaced during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Various foods in the open air case near the deli area were observed between 46-50 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and foods that were out of temperature for an unknown amount of time were voluntarily disposed of. Open air case was observed at ranging ambient temperatures of 39-50 degrees Fahrenheit with condensation droplets observed pooling at top of unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Deli meats were observed held at 47-50 degrees Fahrenheit in grab and go case. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were recently sliced and placed into walk-in cooler to chill. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

-The open air case by the deli area was observed at ranging ambient temperatures of 39-50 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit was taken out of service during time of inspection. Service call was placed during time of inspection. -Seafood walk-in cooler was observed at 43 degrees Fahrenheit. All seafood were in styrofoam coolers with ice and in correct temperatures. Service call was placed during time of inspection. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The following were observed in poor repair: 1. deli walk-in cooler coving 2. deli wall 3. deli warewashing area floor tiles and grout Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2025
The date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2025

Food contact surfaces of the slicer were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2025

A written consumer advisory is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2025

The following was observed in poor repair: 1. deli walk-in cooler coving 2. deli wall 3. deli warewashing area floor tiles and grout 4. deli 3 bay sink splashboard caulking 5. meat room wall The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2025
The sliding door to the Deli Display Case was not in good repair. Sliding door observed cracked. Equipment shall be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2023

The cutting boards in the Deli Dept and Seafood Dept are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/23/2023

The 3 bay sink in the Produce Dept is also used as a food prep sink. The 3 bay sink is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/30/2023

The floor tiles in the Deli Dept and floor tiles in the Meat Dept area observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Floors shall be smooth, durable, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2023
